devto.diagnosis: Claude API unavailable — manual investigation required.

The Dev.to API key stored in GitHub secret DevTO_TWTF1_API_Key has expired or been revoked, causing 401 Unauthorized errors on all Dev.to syndication attempts. The health check script correctly identifies this as an authentication failure requiring secret rotation.
instructions: Log into your Dev.to account at https://dev.to/settings/account
Navigate to Settings → Extensions → API Keys
Revoke the current API key associated with the roadsideamericatowing account (if present)
Generate a new API key and copy it
Go to your GitHub repository settings → Secrets and variables → Actions
Update the secret DevTO_TWTF1_API_Key with the new Dev.to API key value
If you have a DevTO_TWTF2_API_Key configured, verify it is also valid by testing at https://dev.to/api/articles/me/published with the header 'api-key: [key]'
Re-run the syndication system for the next article to verify the fix
